FirstOrderToBottleUptakeMap.definition: Converts a first-order rate constant to a mass-normalised bottle uptake rate: rate = k * n_gas / m_soil; requires headspace gas amount and soil mass.
FirstOrderToBottleUptakeMap.label: first-order constant to bottle uptake map

GravimetricToVolumetricMap.definition: Converts gravimetric to volumetric water content: theta_v = theta_g * rho_b / rho_w; requires a bulk-density assumption.
GravimetricToVolumetricMap.label: gravimetric to volumetric water content map

MatricToTotalPotentialMap.definition: Adds the osmotic (and other) components to the matric potential; requires a solute (here NaCl) osmotic-potential assumption.
MatricToTotalPotentialMap.label: matric to total water potential map

VolumetricToMatricPotentialMap.definition: Converts volumetric water content to matric potential through a water-retention curve; requires retention-curve parameters (including porosity) as assumptions.
VolumetricToMatricPotentialMap.label: volumetric water content to matric potential map

ArealH2FluxEndpoint.definition: Net exchange of dihydrogen between a soil surface and the atmosphere per unit ground area and time, in nmol H2 m-2 s-1 (negative = uptake in the source sign convention).
ArealH2FluxEndpoint.label: areal H2 flux endpoint

BiomassEndpoint.definition: Living biomass of a stated organism group per unit sample.
BiomassEndpoint.label: biomass endpoint

DNARecoveryEndpoint.definition: Total extractable DNA recovered per unit sample, including relic DNA.
DNARecoveryEndpoint.label: DNA recovery endpoint

FirstOrderRateConstantEndpoint.definition: Rate constant k of a first-order decline of headspace gas amount, in s-1 (convertible from h-1 by dividing by 3600).
FirstOrderRateConstantEndpoint.denominator: time (headspace amount is not a denominator)
FirstOrderRateConstantEndpoint.label: first-order rate constant endpoint

GenomeEquivalentsEndpoint.definition: Estimated number of genome copies of a marker-defined guild from single-copy-gene-normalised read counts.
GenomeEquivalentsEndpoint.denominator: sample as normalised in the source table
GenomeEquivalentsEndpoint.label: genome equivalents endpoint

GenomicCapacityEndpoint.definition: Presence or share of genomes encoding a capacity (gene content); says nothing about expression or activity.
GenomicCapacityEndpoint.label: genomic capacity endpoint

GravimetricWaterContentEndpoint.definition: Mass of water per mass of dry soil (g g-1).
GravimetricWaterContentEndpoint.label: gravimetric water content endpoint

MappedReadCompositionEndpoint.definition: Composition of the mapped read pool (shares of reads mapped to reference genomes).
MappedReadCompositionEndpoint.label: mapped-read composition endpoint

MappedReadShareEndpoint.definition: Fraction of reads mapped to the reference MAG set that belong to a stated MAG class (denominator: mapped reads). A kind of mapped-read composition.
MappedReadShareEndpoint.label: mapped-read share endpoint

MassNormalizedBottleUptakeRateEndpoint.definition: Gas uptake rate measured in a closed bottle incubation and normalised by soil mass, in nmol H2 h-1 g-1 soil.
MassNormalizedBottleUptakeRateEndpoint.label: mass-normalized bottle uptake rate endpoint

MatricWaterPotentialEndpoint.definition: Matric component of soil water potential (pressure units; reported in MPa, negative when dry).
MatricWaterPotentialEndpoint.denominator: none (energy per unit volume of water)
MatricWaterPotentialEndpoint.label: matric water potential endpoint

PhysiologicalActivityEndpoint.definition: Measured physiological rate (for example gas uptake) of a community.
PhysiologicalActivityEndpoint.label: physiological activity endpoint

TotalWaterPotentialEndpoint.definition: Total soil water potential including at least matric and osmotic components (pressure units).
TotalWaterPotentialEndpoint.denominator: none (energy per unit volume of water)
TotalWaterPotentialEndpoint.label: total water potential endpoint

ViableDNAEndpoint.definition: DNA from cells with intact membranes (viable fraction).
ViableDNAEndpoint.label: viable DNA endpoint

VolumetricWaterContentEndpoint.definition: Volume of water per bulk soil volume (cm3 cm-3).
VolumetricWaterContentEndpoint.label: volumetric water content endpoint
